'''Ryan Tebow''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Lacey tournament]] on 8 January 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down (three Vaders, three battleground sites)]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HBX (Hidden Base X-wings)]], according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d168">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-11-lacey-washington-01082000d168/ lacey-washington-01082000], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 11 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-11-lacey-washington-01082000d168/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
